g.text: tested, then actively aligned. Passive self-alignment recently shown [10].

g.text: Pit etched down to the Si substrate. The oxide is removed (Sec. 8.3.3) to

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: improve heat flow (thermal conductivity) and so the laser’s gain layer sits

g.text: level with the Si waveguide. Coupled with a waveguide or directly butt-coupled.

g.text: Takeaway: a co-packaged laser feeds the chip from ABOVE (grating coupler: reflector + lens, or a VCSEL) or from the SIDE (edge coupler).
